$comment: OfficeIMO built-in themes. Maps 1:1 onto OfficeIMO.Core/Themes (M1). Lengths are points (OfficeLength.Points). Colours are RRGGBB literals or OfficeColor role names (Accent1-6, Text, TextMuted, Background, Success, Warning, Danger); palette entries are always literal. 'extensions' and 'derived' map onto the remaining theme components (text style, surfaces, page, footer, table and chart details); OfficeIMO.Core/Themes/generate_theme_builtins.py generates the built-in themes from this file; 'checks' is generated and must not be edited by hand.
generatedBy: build_themes.py (design source and colour checks; mockups are generated from this file)

derivationRules.statusFill: status colour composited over the background at 12 % (light themes) or 18 % (Dark)
derivationRules.accent1Tint: Accent1 composited over the background at 10 %

themes.name: Modern
themes.intent: Default. Clean sans-serif, cobalt accent, airy tables with a tinted header. For status reports, exports, dashboards and anything generated without a brief.

seriesColourVision.method: Machado et al. 2009 full-severity matrices in linear sRGB; CIEDE2000 minimum over all pairs; greyscale = WCAG relative luminance; lightness = CIE L*
